\noindent\textit{Reading note.} Each reported value is the mean of run-level values over $n{=}30$ independent runs with a two-sided 95\% percentile bootstrap confidence interval ($10{,}000$ resamples, seed~$20260906$) computed across runs, not across within-run samples.
